learning_gaps.concept_name: Distributive Property of Multiplication over Addition
learning_gaps.description: Student failed to distribute the external multiplier factor to the constant term inside parentheses: 2(x + 3) yielded 2x + 3 instead of 2x + 6.

misconceptions.identified_misconception: Distribution Sign and Constant Multiplier Omission
misconceptions.explanation: You multiplied the variable but forgot to distribute the multiplier to the constant (2 * x + 3 = 10 -> 2x = 7 -> x = 3.5).

recommended_interventions.title: Interactive Distributive Property Visualizer & Balance Scale
actionable_steps: Review visual area grid model demonstrating 2 * (x + 3) = 2x + 6
Retest and solve the multi-step equation 2(x + 3) = 10

summary_narrative: Diagnostic analysis confirms a Distribution Error. When solving 2(x + 3) = 10, the factor 2 was multiplied by x but omitted from the constant 3, resulting in 2x + 3 = 10 and the erroneous answer x = 3.5. Mastery is currently estimated at 50% with priority remediation assigned to distributive property expansion.
